patterns.note: Sections are presented in a clean, single-column flow with generous vertical spacing, often using full-width background color blocks to delineate content areas.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, uppercase numeric labels for section introductions.
A muted, earthy green/teal accent color is used for key content blocks, providing a soft contrast against the dominant light background.
The hero section features a full-bleed video playing in the background, providing dynamic visual interest upon page load.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, ensuring constant access to navigation links.
The footer includes a large, semi-transparent watermark of the company logo, adding a subtle brand presence at the bottom of the page.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-width video as a background element, with textual content and calls to action overlaid directly on top for immediate engagement.
The primary navigation is implemented as a sticky header, fixing it to the top of the browser window after the initial scroll, ensuring constant access to key links.
Content sections below the hero are revealed by simply scrolling into the viewport, maintaining a clean and direct content flow without complex scroll-triggered animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, uppercase numeric labels and clear, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on input fields and buttons, with sharp corners for main content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated use of a full-bleed video hero combined with a muted, earthy green accent color that feels both modern and calming. The large, semi-transparent logo watermark in the footer also adds a unique and memorable brand touch.
